routes.label: Compare the time for one lap

question: Elisa swims laps in the pool. When she first started, she completed \(10\) laps in \(25\) minutes. Now, she can finish \(12\) laps in \(24\) minutes. By how many minutes has she improved her lap time?
solution:
Compare the time for one lap in each case by dividing the total time by the number of laps. Her original lap time was
\[
25\div10=2.5\text{ minutes},
\]
and her current lap time is
\[
24\div12=2\text{ minutes}.
\]
Her improvement is the decrease in time per lap:
\[
2.5-2=0.5=\frac12\text{ minute}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\frac12}\), choice A.
